programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source = '''from collections import deque


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if not color or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if (0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and
                            grid[ny][nx] == color and (ny, nx) not in seen):
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        q.append((ny, nx))
            top = min(y for y, x in cells)
            bottom = max(y for y, x in cells)
            left = min(x for y, x in cells)
            right = max(x for y, x in cells)
            cell_set = set(cells)
            frame = (all((top, x) in cell_set for x in range(left, right + 1)) and
                     all((bottom, x) in cell_set for x in range(left, right + 1)) and
                     all((y, left) in cell_set for y in range(top, bottom + 1)) and
                     all((y, right) in cell_set for y in range(top, bottom + 1)))
            objects.append({'color': color, 'cells': cells, 'frame': frame,
                            'top': top, 'bottom': bottom})

    result = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for is_frame, upward in ((True, True), (False, False)):
        group = [o for o in objects if o['frame'] == is_frame]
        group.sort(key=lambda o: o['top'] if upward else -o['bottom'])
        placed = []
        for obj in group:
            cells = obj['cells']
            dy = -1 if upward else 1
            while True:
                moved = [(y + dy, x) for y, x in cells]
                if any(y < 0 or y >= h for y, x in moved):
                    break
                if any((y, x) in occupied for y, x in moved for occupied in placed):
                    break
                cells = moved
            placed.extend(cells)
            for y, x in cells:
                result[y][x] = obj['color']
    return result
'''
